description: A React component for displaying and managing a list of channels in the Mattermost admin console, including search, pagination, filtering, and navigation to channel details.

classes.name: ChannelList
classes.description: React component for listing channels with search, filter, and pagination features in the admin console.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial load of channel data when component mounts.

methods.name: isSearching
methods.description: Determines if a search or filter is active based on term and filters.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates pagination display info such as start and end counts.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of channel data, either via search or default data fetch.

methods.name: searchChannels
methods.description: Performs a search for channels matching the term and filters.

methods.name: searchChannelsDebounced
methods.description: Debounced version of searchChannels to limit frequent calls.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of channels.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input and triggers data reload.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the data grid.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates the rows for the data grid based on current data and filters.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Applies filters to channel list and reloads data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the channel list component with data grid, filters, and pagination.
